item.title: Zahid lauds Sultan of Pahang’s commitment to rural, Orang Asli welfare
item.description: Deputy Prime Minister Ahmad Zahid Hamidi praises Sultan of Pahang's focus on Orang Asli rights and rural development, calling it a catalyst for inclusive empowerment.

item.title: Sabah flood evacuees rise to 5,860 across five districts
item.description: Flood victims in Sabah increase to 5,860 people from 2,067 families, with evacuees housed in 29 relief centres across five districts as waters continue to rise.

item.title: Algerian archbishop hails Pope’s visit as a ‘dream come true’

item.title: Three Palapes instructors plead not guilty to cadet’s death
item.description: Three Malaysian Armed Forces officers charged with causing the death of a UTM cadet plead not guilty in the Sessions Court.

item.title: Bersih: PM tenure limit bill does not affect Agong’s powers
item.description: The proposed 10-year limit for a prime minister does not encroach on the constitutional powers of the Yang di-Pertuan Agong, says electoral reform group Bersih.

item.title: Seven arrested over shooting of border agency commander’s car
item.description: Police detain seven suspects, including a Thai woman, following a brazen shooting targeting a senior border security commander's vehicle in Kedah.

item.title: Company director pleads not guilty to forging bank statements
item.description: A company director faces three forgery charges for allegedly falsifying bank statements to cheat, with a bail set at RM20,000 and a court mention in April.
